subject: Renewal alignment + optional early-upgrade credits — proposal and next steps
messages:
-----Message 1-----
From: Emily Turner <emily@acmebio.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@acmebio.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning renewals across business units + upgrade credits?

Hi David,

Quick note following our call this morning — Acme is looking to simplify our vendor relationships and co-term two existing Redwood agreements (R-Alpha and R-Beta) so both renew on 2028-10-01. We want a multi-year option (2 or 3 years) that lets us ramp usage over the first 12 months (we expect 40% YoY growth across models) and an early-upgrade credit if we move to a larger reserved tier within year 1.

Questions for you:
- Can Redwood do a 3-year with a front-loaded credit (to offset early cost while we ramp)?
- Can auto-renew be disabled? Our procurement needs explicit renewal signoff.
- Any impact if we co-term R-Beta under the same billing entity vs keeping it separate?

I attached the rough renewal requirements (internal). Procurement will be in touch to start redlines.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Turner
Head of Platform Operations
Acme BioWorks

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Requirements.pdf

-----Message 2-----
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily@acmebio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewals across business units + upgrade credits?

Emily — great to hear this alignment direction. High-level response: yes, we can support a multi-year co-term with a staged ramp and an explicit early-upgrade credit. A few important implementation details and trade-offs below so you can share with procurement: 

1) Term/Auto-renew: we can deliver a 2- or 3-year term with auto-renew disabled (explicit signoff required). That typically requires an alternate billing rule in our billing system (we'll surface a renewal reminder 90/45/30 days and hold auto-collect).

2) Ramp structure: recommended default is a 12-month staged ramp with the following buckets: 30% year 1, 70% year 2 for a 2-year, or 25%/35%/40% across three years for a 3-year. The goal is to ensure unit pricing steps down as committed volume increases.

3) Early-upgrade credit: we can provide a pro-rated credit equal to 20% of the incremental committed spend if you upgrade to the next reserved tier within the first 9 months. Credit applies as account-level billing credit (not transferable).

4) Co-term considerations: consolidating R-Alpha and R-Beta under one billing entity simplifies true-ups and gives you more leverage on unit pricing, but it also couples usage spikes across teams which can complicate internal chargebacks. If you prefer separate internal showback, we can keep logical sub-accounts with a single invoice.

5) Procurement/redlines: please send the procurement contact to me; Marissa will own the contract redline and finance coordination. I'll attach a draft that outlines the three options (2yr/3yr/co-term with sub-account).

Next steps: I attached a draft renewal (Acme_Renewal_Draft_v2.pdf) and an SOW for Phase 1 migration between contracts (SOW-Phase1.xlsx). If this looks acceptable we can prepare a DocuSign with two signature blocks (legal & procurement) and route to your procurement inbox.

- David
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Acme_Renewal_Draft_v2.pdf; SOW-Phase1.xlsx

-----Message 3-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Turner <emily@acmebio.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewals across business units + upgrade credits?

David/Emily — looped in finance notes below for clarity. We prefer a 3-year with quarterly true-ups for usage above committed bands; billing will be monthly for overages and annual for committed spend unless Acme requests prepayment. Key items: 

- Billing cadence: standard is annual committed invoice with monthly usage true-up. If Acme wants monthly committed billing (to match their internal cadence) we can modify but that will affect discount bands.
- Credit accounting: early-upgrade credit will be issued as a contra-invoice line and applied in the next billing period following the upgrade event.
- SOW: phase 1 needs signature prior to the contract effective date to schedule migration.

Marissa will own setting the billing terms and the DocuSign envelope once language is accepted. Neha, please weigh in on revenue recognition for the 3-year structure (Neha handles ARR and finance flags).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference

-----Message 4-----
From: Procurement <procurement@acmebio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@acmebio.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T08:56:00-07:00
Subject: Acme redlines and questions (R-Alpha + R-Beta co-terming)

Marissa/David — attached are the procurement redlines for the master services agreement and the SOW. High level:

- We require explicit opt-in for auto-renew (disable by default) and a 60-day advance notice for renewal elections.
- Limitations of liability: small edits requested for clarity only.
- We need the early-upgrade credit spelled out in the SOW with precise milestone triggers and an example calculation.
- Billing: prefer monthly committed billing for internal chargeback; ask if Redwood can provide an internal invoice breakdown by sub-account.

Can you confirm the timeline for sign-off? We are aiming to complete legal and procurement approvals by 2027-08-25.

- Procurement (on behalf of Acme)
Attachment: ACME_Redlines_MSA_v1.docx

-----Message 5-----
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@acmebio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Turner <emily@acmebio.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme redlines and questions (R-Alpha + R-Beta co-terming)

Thanks for the redlines — we reviewed with legal and can accept the majority of the language with a few minor clarifications (tracked in the attached draft). Specific confirmations: 

- Auto-renew: we'll disable auto-renew and add the 60-day renewal notification plus the 90/60/30 reminder cadence internally.
- Early-upgrade credit: confirmed 20% of incremental committed spend (as previously proposed). We'll add an example table in the SOW for transparency.
- Billing breakdown: Marissa — finance can expose sub-account showback lines on the invoice. We will provide a sample invoice prior to sign-off so Acme can validate internal chargeback.

Next steps: Marissa will upload the final DocuSign envelope (Acme_Renewal_Draft_v2.pdf) with two signature blocks. Please confirm routing emails for DocuSign. If Procurement confirms by 08/20 we can hit your internal approval timeline.

Cheers,
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Draft_v2_FINAL_with_tracked_changes.pdf
